meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 面对你的问题,Claude 会召集 4-6 个思维原型角色(架构师、反调者、务实派等),让每个角色从自己的角度给出立场和推理,最后输出综合结论:共识点、核心张力、推荐路径和置信度。
howto.when: 当你遇到没有明显答案的两难、权衡或复杂选择,想从多个角度分析,或说「council mode」「mind council」等词时触发。

say.text: 开个议会,帮我权衡要不要辞掉稳定工作去创业
say.note: 会召集多位原型,再给出综合结论

say.text: 用 deep council 深度审议这个定价方案
say.note: 改用 6 位成员并展开更长推理

say.text: 加上反调者,反驳我最想选的那个方案
say.note: 把指定原型加入议会名单

howto.what_en: Claude convenes 4-6 thinking archetypes (Architect, Contrarian, Pragmatist, and others) on your question; each gives a distinct stance and reasoning, then it synthesizes convergence, core tension, a recommended path, and a confidence level.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you face a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer, want multi-angle analysis, or say “council mode” or “mind council”.

say_en.text: Run a mind council on whether I should quit my job to start a company
Use deep council to deliberate on this pricing plan
Add the Contrarian to argue against my favorite option
say_en.note: Adds that archetype to the panel
